subject.title: feat(ios): unify chat and voice experience

question: Should OpenClaw permanently remove the standalone iOS Talk destination and make Chat the sole user-facing entry point for dictation, voice notes, and realtime voice?
rationale: This is a deliberate user-facing navigation and upgrade-policy decision, not a mechanical defect fix; tests and real-device proof cannot determine whether the product should retain a separate Talk surface.

options.title: Adopt unified Chat
options.body: Approve Chat as the permanent single conversational surface, with the existing talk/voice aliases routing users into Chat.

options.title: Keep Talk separate
options.body: Retain a standalone Talk destination and narrow this branch to reusable ownership, safety, and Live Activity improvements only.

options.title: Defer the navigation decision
options.body: Pause this PR until iOS owners define the desired long-term Chat/Talk information architecture and upgrade messaging.

recommendation.title: Adopt unified Chat
recommendation.body: Approve Chat as the permanent single conversational surface, with the existing talk/voice aliases routing users into Chat.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied timeline explicitly routed the initial compatibility and product review to this participant; exact code ownership remains unconfirmed.
